selectionProcess.name: CUET (PG) score (NTA), paper COQP12
selectionProcess.detail: Registration for DAVV counselling at davv.mponline.gov.in; graduation in any stream with min. 50% (5% relaxation for MP-domicile reserved categories and PwD).

selectionProcess.name: DAVV counselling on CUET (PG) merit
selectionProcess.detail: Merit solely on CUET (PG) score; ties broken by age.

keyDates.notes: 2026-27 cycle: DAVV counselling registration closed 10 Jun 2026. 2027-28 dates not published as of 2026-11-12. IIPS also runs MBA (Management Science) 2-year and 5-year integrated programmes; their 2026 admission route is not stated in the CUET (PG) brochure and they are not listed here.
